stem: After Diwali, Meena's grandmother adds fallen leaves and vegetable peels to the compost pit behind their house in Nagpur. A few weeks later, most of this dead matter has broken down into dark soil-like material. Which organisms are mainly responsible for this breakdown?

options.text: earthworms only, which eat all the dead matter by themselves
decomposers such as fungi and bacteria, which feed on dead matter and waste
green plants, which absorb the dead matter through their roots
birds and insects, which carry the dead matter away to their nests

teacher.key_rationale: Fungi and bacteria are decomposer microorganisms that grow on dead matter and waste, breaking it down into simpler substances; the other options name consumers or producers that do not perform decomposition.
